generate_gmock_class: generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file with specified class names
generate_gmock_all_classes: generate Google Mock classes for all virtual classes in a C++ header file
generate_gmock_templated: generate Google Mock classes for templated C++ classes with MOCK_METHOD_T macros
generate_gmock_const_methods: generate Google Mock classes with MOCK_CONST_METHOD macros for const virtual functions
generate_gmock_custom_indent: generate Google Mock classes with custom indentation via the INDENT environment variable
